title: Procurement Coordinator - Saudi Only
description: Official Radisson Hotel Group procurement role at Nofa Resort Riyadh focused on supporting day-to-day purchasing and cost-control work for hotel operations. The role covers sourcing quality products, supporting financial process control, handling enquiries and problem resolution, delivering procurement tasks on time, helping control costs and inventory with the manager, maintaining working relationships, and supporting audit and compliance follow-up. Hotel purchasing experience is beneficial but not essential, making this a cleaner adjacent-fit coordinator role than the more senior procurement openings.
